news.headline: Trump pushes his $5,000 'dividend' pledge if GOP wins midterms. Republican candidates, not as much
news.summary: President Donald Trump came to battleground North Carolina doubling down on a tantalizing and implausible midterm promise. “If we win," he said, “we’re going to get you $5,000. So that’s it. Very simple.”
